purpose: Compare charging locations against their own demonstrated session-derived power baseline, identify persistent shortfall and explain estimated annual time lost.
primaryGoal: Identify which previously used charging locations are underperforming without confusing inferred health, insufficient observations or retained history with measured charger condition.

dataSources.behavior: Workspace-selected vehicle ID; no competing local selector. Hook implementation not inspected.
Enabled only with vehicle ID; vehicle-specific chargingKeys.byVehicle cache; AbortSignal forwarded; safeArray selection; no explicit bounds, limit, polling or page-level query policy overrides.
dataSources.sourceOwnership: v1 ChargingHandler -> chargingsvc.Service.GetByVehicleID -> ChargingSessionRepository. Service forwards repository records without mapping. Endpoint existence is confirmed; actual response compatibility is not.
dataSources.risk: The registered handler returns internal/domain/charging.ChargingSession, whose JSON tags differ materially from the frontend ChargingSession used by the analysis. See architectureIssues.

dataSources.behavior: Retained payload survives refresh error/offline pause; fatal errors require no retained data; historical provenance describes the source, while inferred analysis is explained separately.

Pure memoized derived model; place-name/rounded-coordinate grouping; minimum 600 seconds and 2000 Wh; taper exclusion above 80% SoC; four clean sessions to rate; up to five recent clean sessions; high-quantile baseline; ratios below 0.9 slipping and below 0.75 degraded; inferred AC/DC above observed 25000 W; annualized usage-shortfall estimate; worst-first then energy ordering.
dataSources.units: Derived power W, energy Wh, duration seconds; specialist hoursLostPerYear retained and converted to seconds for shared duration rendering. Existing duration_min activity fallback is interpreted as minutes, not changed or generalized.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: One source notice is rendered under metrics, above the chart and inside locations. In refresh failure/offline cases this repeats warnings and retry controls for the same source. Independent source shells are intentional, but repeated alert intensity may distract.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Review mounted failure states before changing; keep local trust visibility and retained content, and use the existing hideRetry contract where redundant controls are demonstrably unnecessary.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Desktop render/export callbacks and mobile displayValue share local formatting helpers. This is an adapter for DataTable rather than evidence for a second table system.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain the existing helper reuse and allColumns details pipeline; do not extract a competing charger-specific table or duplicate mobile details.

states.noVehicle: Page returns NoVehicleSelected and onboarding guidance; sessions hook disabled.
states.initialLoading: No retained payload, no fatal error and no offline pause produces metrics loading, chart loading and a 180px locations skeleton.
states.emptyHistory: Resolved [] is hasData=true in DataState. Site count can truthfully be zero; underperforming/fastest/time lost remain unknown without rated sites. Chart and locations show separate explanatory empties.
states.insufficientCleanSessions: Locations remain visible with unknown badge; baseline sentinel is rendered as an em dash, not measured zero. Chart excludes unknown sites.
states.fatalError: Metrics/locations show QueryError; chart owns its error/retry surface. PageContainer is not given an error gate that erases all shells.
states.refreshError: Cached summary, chart and rows remain visible with repeated nonblocking StaleRefreshWarning and retained source label.
states.offlinePaused: No payload produces paused status and retry, not a perpetual loading skeleton; retained payload is stale and kept visible.
states.refreshing: Page busy uses isRefreshing; current content is retained; warning retry disables while refreshing.
states.partialUnknown: Four metric values independently distinguish missing benchmarks from source-present zero. There is no partial source fan-out on this page.
states.trust: Returned history period is explicitly unknown, not a lifetime guarantee; fastest is demonstrated baseline, not hardware rating; annualized time loss is an estimate; AC/DC is inferred.
states.runtime: All transitions are source-inspected only; no query/network/browser state was exercised.

visualIssues.detail: Baseline reference and healthy bars both use chartTokens.series[2] (amber #f59e0b); slipping uses series[3] (red #ef4444); degraded uses series[5] (cyan #06b6d4). These saturated hues give a target the same emphasis as data and disagree with locations' success/warning/danger meanings.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing subdued reference token and governed semantic chart-color mapping; preserve thresholds, every plotted value and saved theme/chart choices. Coordinate shared palette changes rather than adding local hex colors.

architectureIssues.detail: Endpoint is real, but its registered v1 handler returns domain ChargingSession with startedAt/completedAt/energyAddedWh/startBatteryLevel/endBatteryLevel and no place/coordinates. analyzeChargerHealth instead needs started_at or start_ts, ended_at or duration_min, total_energy_added_wh, start_soc_pct/end_soc_pct and start_place or coordinates. Service.GetByVehicleID forwards the records without mapping. Merely asserting request<frontend ChargingSession[]> cannot supply those fields. This can turn genuine history into an empty inferred analysis. Current runtime payload and resilientFetch transformation were not exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must reconcile the actual wire DTO, repository source and typed hook under the preservation contract, including timestamps, SI energy/duration, SoC and real location identity. Do not silently substitute useChargingHistory, add queries, fabricate sites or alter limits/window/cache keys in a page-only makeover.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports LayoutCard and useCardPlacement from the layout-reference implementation path; chart also directly imports useCardPlacement, and stats imports types from stat-reference. Canonical PageLayout/CardGrid and UI/chart barrels are otherwise reused.
architectureIssues.fix: Use category exports where available; shared barrel owner must confirm/export missing placement/type contracts before any caller-only cleanup. Do not duplicate the reference implementation.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart fallback/export baseline/recent operands are fixed kW conversions, while locations and power metrics use current useUnits/useOperationalMetrics. The existing frozen chart explicitly preserves historical kW operands. This is display-contract debt, not evidence that hook/cache SI was mutated.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep W/Wh sources and existing export scope intact; integration/formatting owners must decide specialist display parity explicitly before changing labels or values. Do not rewrite the pure analysis to display units.

priority.reason: Resolve the source DTO/location compatibility risk before cosmetic acceptance; page already uses shared modernized layouts, source-local trust states, typed metrics and mobile details. Secondary work is chart semantic color/reference emphasis and real responsive/a11y validation.

competingImplementations.name: Existing /charging-sessions versus /charging history sources
competingImplementations.detail: Two real endpoint families exist. The page deliberately consumes ordinary useChargingSessions, not useChargingHistory(limit=1000) or getChargingSessions(limit=50). They are not interchangeable during cosmetic modernization.

competingImplementations.detail: Shared OperationalBrief, ChartContainer, DataTable, LayoutCard, Badge and trust contract are reused. Deep reference imports are contract leakage, not proof of a new UI library.
